newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet on Friday, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said. Inquiry and demand rather light as show lists are sold out. Bids and asking prices not well established.
Last week 97,700 head confirmed including 20,800 head or about 21 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - none week ago - 1,000 year ago - 3,500
